name: rfd4_proteina_design
description: Design biomolecules with RFD4-Proteina. The input is an annotated mmCIF whose annotations ARE the design specification: what to hold fixed by coordinate and by sequence, which residues are hotspots, which regions to generate. One call covers every task upstream serves -- de novo monomers, protein and DNA binders, motif scaffolding, enzyme active-site scaffolding, small-molecule binders, antibody and TCR CDR redesign, partial diffusion and inverse folding -- because which one you get is a property of the annotations, not of a mode. Returns each design's per-chain sequence; the mmCIF text itself is opt-in.

input_cif.description: The annotated mmCIF text. An ordinary unannotated structure is not a design specification and will be refused. Upstream's examples/ directory has one per design shape.

num_replicates.description: Independent designs from the one specification, 1 to 8. Each holds the GPU for a whole rollout, so this multiplies the wall clock.

recycle_strategy.description: Compute preset. The three differ only in how often the trunk is recycled over 60 steps: thinking_low 120 trunk passes, thinking_medium 180, thinking_high 300.

inference_backend.description: 'native' runs the workflow in torch; 'bioir' runs it through NVIDIA's BioNeMo Inference Runtime, which captures a CUDA graph. See this provider's README for what each measured on the verified card before choosing.

seed.description: Random seed. Omit for a random one.

return_structures.description: Return the designed mmCIF text as well as the sequences. Off by default: replicates of mmCIF are megabytes, and a transport truncates an oversized reply into invalid JSON rather than refusing it.
